hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: The Coworker MCP is connected. It is the source of truth for THIS company's knowledge — people, teams, decisions, policies, projects, customers, and connected tools (Slack, Jira, GitHub, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google, BigQuery, Snowflake), plus the OM2 knowledge graph. When the user asks anything that depends on internal/organizational knowledge, ground the answer in Coworker rather than answering from prior knowledge: call individual_context once early to learn who the user is and what data they can access; use memory_retrieval and (when om2_* tools are present) om2_search before connector-specific search; and use identify_people when people are named. Cite the source behind internal claims, and if Coworker returns nothing relevant, say so instead of guessing. Detailed playbooks are maintained server-side and may be newer than anything bundled here — retrieve them with skill_retrieve when relevant: mcp-company-data-cascade (search order), mcp-om2-usage (knowledge graph), mcp-data-quality (conflicting/stale sources), mcp-document-retrieval (reading linked documents).
